evidence.intree_statement: Program Definition EilenbergMoore `(T : C ⟶ C) `{H : @Monad C T} : Category := {| obj := ∃ a : C, @TAlgebra C T H a; hom := fun x y => TAlgebraHom T ``x ``y (projT2 x) (projT2 y); … |} — the Eilenberg–Moore category X^T (= C^T) whose forgetful functor U^T : C^T → C, (a, ν) ↦ a is the target of the lifting in the exercise.

Class TAlgebra `(T : C ⟶ C) `{@Monad C T} (a : C) := { t_alg : T a ~> a; t_id : t_alg ∘ ret ≈ id; t_action : t_alg ∘ fmap t_alg ≈ t_alg ∘ join } — the object-level action of the monad T on an object a (the pointwise ingredient of a T-action on an endofunctor).

statement_record.book: (Dubuc 1970) For a monad ⟨T,η,μ⟩ on X, T has an action on an endofunctor S : X → X iff S lifts to the Eilenberg–Moore category X^T as S = G^T S'; such actions correspond one-to-one with the liftings S' : X → X^T.
statement_record.intree: EilenbergMoore : the category X^T with forgetful U^T; TAlgebra T a : an action of T on an OBJECT a (t_alg : T a ~> a with unit and associativity laws); TAlgebraHom : algebra homomorphisms.
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker: the Eilenberg–Moore category X^T, its forgetful functor U^T = G^T, and the object-level monad action TAlgebra are present, but the exercise's actual content — the notion of a T-action on an ENDOFUNCTOR S (a T-algebra structure on S in the functor category [X,X], i.e. a natural α : T S → S with the algebra laws), the lifting S' : X → X^T satisfying G^T S' = S, and the bijection {T-actions on S} ↔ {liftings S'} — is not formalized.

The strength_comparison is honest that the specific content — a T-action on an endofunctor S (natural TS => S), the lifting S':X->X^T with G^T S'=S, and the bijection — is entirely unformalized; a reader is not misled.
